definition.en: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) is a member of the World Bank Group focused exclusively on the private sector in developing countries.
definition.hi: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) is a member of the World Bank Group focused exclusively on the private sector in developing countries.

importanceInUpsc.en: The IFC is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it highlights the role of private capital in economic development and infrastructure financing. Understanding its operations helps in analyzing India's external sector, foreign direct investment (FDI) trends, and public-private partnership (PPP) models.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the mandate of IFC in promoting private sector growth.
